summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a binding term sheet to restructure approximately US$82.2 million of subsidiary LVMSA's commercial bank debt, extending maturity from September 2026 to March 2030. The revised terms include a six-month principal grace period, then 36 months of quarterly amortization with monthly interest. Lenders include Banco do Brasil, BTG Pactual, Bradesco, Santander Brasil, and Caixa Econômica Federal. Definitive documentation remains pending, including interest rate, collateral package, and closing conditions. The restructuring supports Largo's operational plans and strategic review of tungsten assets. What to watch: final documentation and execution risk.
